name: Stinking milk-vetch
desc: Stinking milk-vetch (Astragalus praelongus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 11 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Astragalus praelongus (stinking milkvetch) is a perennial plant in the legume family (Fabaceae) found in the Colorado Plateau and Canyonlands region of the southwestern United States.
